case_number: 2024 INSC 686; CIVIL APPEAL NO. OF 2024 (Arising out of Special Leave Petition (Civil) No. 23320 of 2023)
summary: Interpretation of Section 29A(4)-(5) Arbitration and Conciliation Act; validity of extension applications filed post-mandate termination; conflict between High Courts resolved; extension permissible after expiry period; mandate continues during application pendency; court may reduce arbitrator fees for delays; dismissal of Calcutta High Court judgment; precedent from Delhi, Bombay, Kerala, Madras courts followed; legislative intent for timely arbitration emphasized; retrospective application acknowledged.
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; High Court judgment set aside; extension application permissible post-expiry; mandate continues during pendency of extension application under s.29A(5).
